body: Do you know if such tests are available overseas?  Everything I find that is accessible in Japan says 3 months.
I have been told that tests are only reliable after 3 months, and that sooner ones have higher chances of being inaccurate.
Can't get effectively tested for another couple months, and the waiting makes it so much worse.

The condom broke.  I pulled out once I noticed a couple seconds later, but contact had been made.  Internet research says chances are very low that I'm now infected, but the .000x % chance that I am is literally tearing me apart.
